business.summary: Wires & cables is the profit engine; FMEG is the optionality, still near break-even. Exports are ~7% of revenue and rising.

promises.promise: FMEG to reach EBITDA break-even by FY26 end
promises.delivered: FMEG EBITDA −0.4% in Q4 FY26, +0.6% in Q2 FY27 — two quarters late

promises.promise: Cables & wires capex of ₹1,000–1,100 Cr in FY27
promises.delivered: ₹520 Cr spent in H1 FY27, on run-rate

promises.promise: Exports to cross 10% of revenue in FY27
Hold W&C EBITDA margin in 11–13% band despite copper volatility
Project Spring: 1.5–2× industry growth through FY30

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Demand from real estate and infra remains robust
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Revenue +16.6% YoY in Q2 FY27; cable volumes +20%
CFO/PAT 0.79 over 5y; FY26 CFO ₹2,290 Cr vs PAT ₹2,470 Cr

guidance.guide: ₹20,000 Cr target met; next goal 1.5–2× industry growth to FY30

bull: Category leader with ~26% organised share and pricing power on copper pass-through
Net cash balance sheet funds capex internally
Export and EHV cable capacity opens a higher-margin pool
bear: FMEG still sub-scale; break-even promise slipped twice
Cash conversion below 1× PAT over 5 years
Valuation (42.6× P/E) leaves little room for a demand slowdown
